blocks.orig: Villa Maua, or the House of Flowers, offers nine, spacious rooms, right in the center of Arusha in one of the historic residential areas of the city. All rooms are air-conditioned, ensuite (some with a bath tub), double- or twin-bedded, and offer satellite TV, WiFi, and private verandas overlooking the lush tropical garden full of flowers. Designed for the traveler of today, the clean contemporary decor is complemented by natural hardwood furniture and ‘touches of Africa’. The three dining areas of the hotel offer the opportunity to dine indoors as well as outdoors, with snacks and meals on offer throughout the day. What’s more, there’s a relatively small swimming pool with crystal-clear blue water, an ideal spot to relax, soak up the sun, and cool down!
blocks.html: Villa Maua, also called the House of Flowers, has nine spacious rooms in the centre of Arusha, in one of the city’s historic residential districts. Every room is air-conditioned and en-suite (some have a bath tub), with double or twin beds, satellite TV, WiFi and a private veranda looking out on the lush, flower-filled tropical garden. Made with today’s traveller in mind, the clean modern decor is paired with natural hardwood furniture and ‘touches of Africa’. With three dining areas, the hotel lets you eat inside or outside, and snacks and meals are served all day. There’s also a fairly small swimming pool with crystal-clear blue water, a perfect place to relax, enjoy the sun and cool off!
